test_fused_adam_optimizer_fallback: test that APEX pretrained models crash without --optimizer adam and load correctly with it
test_fp16_model_fallback: test that APEX FP16 pretrained models evaluate correctly with and without fp16 enabled
test_create_agent_with_apex_model: test creating an agent from an APEX pretrained model file using ParlaiParser and create_agent
test_eval_model_with_fp16_tokens: test evaluating an FP16 model with force_fp16_tokens disabled to avoid missing token errors
test_train_model_import_error: test that training an APEX fused adam model raises ImportError when apex is not installed
